title: Selah
gist: A word in the Psalms whose exact meaning is lost. It is thought to mark a pause, an instrument interlude or a lifting of the voice. It appears 71 times in the Hebrew Psalter. The Latin Vulgate and the Douay-Rheims leave it out, which is why you will find it in some translations and not in others.

passages.note: One of the few uses outside the Psalms.
